slides.sub: 6 steps before your first booking. Swipe.

slides.title: Keep the menu short
slides.head: Start with three options.
slides.body: Exterior wash, exterior and interior, and a full detail that you quote after seeing the car.

slides.title: Sort water first
slides.head: Ask before you promise.
slides.body: Check your municipality's water rules, and ask about a tap, a plug point and where you may work.

slides.title: Start with basic kit
slides.head: Buy what you can afford.
slides.body: Two buckets, car shampoo, clean microfibre cloths, wash mitts, a wheel brush and a vacuum.

slides.title: Price the whole job
slides.head: Time, products and travel.
slides.body: Add something for wear on your kit. Charge more for bigger or dirtier cars.

slides.title: Find regulars
slides.head: Go where the cars are.
slides.body: Offices, complexes and small fleets, with permission from whoever manages the site.

slides.title: Check the car first
slides.head: Walk around it with the owner.
slides.body: Note any scratches or damage and take photos before you start washing.
